subject: Request: onboarding surcharge waiver for Nimbus Health pilot - VP/CFO signoff
messages:
From: Sara Lim <sara@nimbushealth.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@nimbushealth.com
Date: 2026-08-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot pricing + onboarding fee question

Hi Vanessa (and Marissa),

Thanks again for the demo earlier — the team at Nimbus is excited to move forward with a six-week pilot focused on our care-coordination workflows. We reviewed the proposal and procurement flagged the standard $25,000 onboarding surcharge on top of the pilot rate. Given this is a time-boxed pilot with limited volume, is there flexibility to remove or reduce that onboarding charge?

If Redwood can waive the onboarding fee for the pilot (we'd still expect standard onboarding and SOW work to be done), we can commit to a follow-on paid proof-of-value and talk about a three-quarter committed term if the pilot meets KPIs.

Looking for a quick yes/no so procurement can clear internal budget.

Best,
Sara
Sara Lim
Head of Digital Products, Nimbus Health
procurement@nimbushealth.com

[Attachment: Nimbus_RFP_summary.pdf]

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-28T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot pricing + onboarding fee question — request for exception

Marissa / Rishi,

Forwarding Nimbus' note. Short background: this is a strategic healthcare buyer with potential for a multi-product deployment across 8 hospital systems. The pilot ask: 6-week, expected ~100k tokens/day peak, embedding + chat usage. Standard commercial would include a $25k onboarding surcharge (professional services + priority onboarding slot). They explicitly want the surcharge waived for the pilot in exchange for a firm conversation about a committed renewal if KPIs are met.

My recommended path: waive the onboarding surcharge for the pilot only, require a signed MOU that converts to a minimum 6-month committed agreement with our entry-tier committed discount if they convert (we capture usage floor). I think that keeps the pilot low friction and protects us commercially.

Attachments: I attached the current proposal, a pricing model with unit economics showing the pilot delta, and a draft exec memo for signoff.

Can you review quickly? They want an answer by end of week. If you want me to formalize the memo for Marcus (CFO) I can — suggested ask is: waive $25k onboarding, allow up to 35% total concession on list price during pilot (we'd normally cap at 20% without exec signoff).

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

[Attachments: proposal-nimbus-2026-08.pdf, pricing-model-nimbus.xlsx, exec-memo-nimbus-onboarding.docx]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-29T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot pricing + onboarding fee question — request for exception

Vanessa — thanks for the clear recommendation and the financials.

I agree with waiving the onboarding surcharge for the pilot only to remove procurement friction. Two asks before I push to Marcus for CFO approval:
1) Add a clause in the MOU that the pilot outcome triggers a 90-day window to negotiate a committed term and that Redwood receives first right to match any competing offers.
2) Limit the concession exposure: cap total onboarding & discount-related revenue impact to $40k NRR-equivalent (so we have a clear threshold).

If you update the exec memo with those items I'll escalate. Given this exceeds our standard 20% concession cap, Marcus needs to sign off. He typically wants the economics shown pro-forma and a short one-paragraph business rationale.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Director, Enterprise Sales
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Thanks for the context. I support the pilot-only waiver with the two guardrails Marissa outlined. Vanessa — please add the MOU language (90-day negotiation window + first right) and quantify the maximum revenue impact in the memo. Make sure the pricing-model tab shows expected token run-rate and the downside scenario (20% conversion).

I'll OK the concession pending Marcus' signoff on the numbers; please route to Marcus with a short cover note highlighting strategic rationale (logo expansion potential across 8 systems + reference customer testimonial).

Rishi Malhotra
VP, Sales
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

On Thu, Aug 29, 2026 at 3:20 PM marissa_cole@redwood.com wrote:
> [manager guidance above]

From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-30T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Pilot pricing + onboarding fee question — CFO decision

Appreciate the concise memo and model. I reviewed the attached pricing-model-nimbus.xlsx and the exec memo. Decision: APPROVED to waive the $25k onboarding surcharge for the six-week pilot only, on the following conditions:

- MOU signed by Nimbus that includes the 90-day negotiation window and first-right-to-match clause.
- Concession impact documented and limited to the $40k NRR-equivalent cap Marissa requested; any overrun requires Finance review.
- Pilot acceptance criteria must be explicit in the SOW and tied to measurable KPIs (reduction in time-to-discharge and extraction accuracy targets).

Vanessa — you can communicate approval to the customer with those contractual guardrails. Please copy Finance (finance_ops@redwood.com) when sending the final MOU.

Marcus Lin
CFO, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
